in_hebrew.name: סֶלֶל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Selle can be derived from the Hebrew word סֶלֶל (selel), which means 'marrow'. In biblical times, the marrow was considered a valuable and nutritious food source.

in_greek.name: Σέλλη
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Selle in Greek has a different meaning. It is derived from the name of the Greek goddess Selene, which means 'Moon'. This name was not commonly used in the Bible, but it can be found in some early Christian texts.

in_latin.name: Sella
